summary: The visual style delivers a clean, consistent 3D beach environment with stylized characters. However, multiple shots fail to illustrate the spoken actions, relying on static props rather than active character interaction.

clean: Shot 0-3: Consistent character rendering and beach background environments.
Shot 9: Character seated at table interacting with the mate gourd.
unclean: Shot 4: Characters stand empty-handed despite dialogue listing items being carried.
Shot 5-6: Thermos sits isolated on a table instead of being held in hand as spoken.
Shot 11-12: No visual representation of wind or yerba blowing into the character's face.

clean: Consistent color palette, lighting, and 3D asset aesthetic throughout.
Text overlay placement is clear and legible.
unclean: Shot 14: End card UI buttons partially obscure character figures.

issues.problem: Text states thermos goes in hand, but scene shows thermos stationary on a table.
issues.fix: Animate character holding the thermos in hand.

issues.problem: Dialogue mentions carrying cooler and thermos, but characters are empty-handed.
issues.fix: Add 3D props of cooler and thermos to character hands.

issues.problem: Dialogue describes wind blowing yerba on face, but no particle effect or reaction is drawn.
issues.fix: Add wind particle effects and yerba flying toward character face.

issues.problem: person cut or head under the subtitle, guard could not fix in 1 shot(s)
issues.fix: fix it at the source in the style (layout, camera plan, visual choice)

issues.problem: Interactive poll UI elements cover character heads at the bottom.
issues.fix: Adjust camera angle slightly upward to keep faces clear of UI buttons.

issues.problem: camera too close (backed off by the guard) in 4 shot(s)
issues.fix: fix it at the source in the style (layout, camera plan, visual choice)

issues.problem: people stood too close (spread by the guard) in 1 shot(s)
issues.fix: fix it at the source in the style (layout, camera plan, visual choice)

learnings.rule: Ensure literal visual actions directly depict key nouns and verbs spoken in the voiceover.
Avoid showing isolated static props on tables when text explicitly describes active handling.
